item.title: Dead star produces shock wave that should not exist
item.description: A dead white dwarf with no detectable disk has produced a powerful shock wave that appears to have lasted at least 1,000 years.

item.title: Worms given magnetic bacteria lived 43% longer
item.description: A magnet-producing bacterium extended the average lifespan of C. elegans worms by over 43% while helping protect their neurological and intestinal health.
